title: code-review-graph read adapters: search, reviewContext, overview, impact, changes
description: Implement the CodeReviewGraphBackend response adapters for the five non-query operations, validated against the fixtures captured in Sprint 4. search -> semantic_search_nodes_tool (SearchHit[] with NodeRef + score/snippet, kind coercion), reviewContext -> get_review_context_tool (string), overview -> get_architecture_overview_tool (string), impact -> get_impact_radius_tool (ImpactReport with root/affected/testsAffected partition), changes -> detect_changes_tool (NodeRef[]). Each adapter's *Plan method returns {tool, params, narrow} exactly like the tokensave backend, so GraphClient's sandbox/staleness/health/fallback logic is reused unchanged.

successCriteria.description: Build + typecheck pass with zero errors.

search: CodeReviewGraphBackend.searchPlan returns {tool:'semantic_search_nodes_tool', params: <query+limit shape>, narrow}, and narrow(fixture) yields SearchHit[] whose NodeRef carries symbol/file/line with kind coerced to the NodeRef kind set, and score/snippet populated where the fixture provides them. Unit-tested against tests/graph/fixtures/cr-graph/semantic_search_nodes_tool.json.

reviewContext (get_review_context_tool) and overview (get_architecture_overview_tool) narrows return the correct string payload from their fixtures (matching how GraphClient.reviewContext/overview consume a string).

impact: impactPlan narrow(fixture from get_impact_radius_tool) yields an ImpactReport with a root NodeRef and affected vs testsAffected partitioned by the test/spec heuristic (or cr-graph's own test edges if the fixture distinguishes them). Unit-tested.
changes: changesPlan narrow(fixture from detect_changes_tool) yields NodeRef[] of changed symbols. Unit-tested.

End-to-end through GraphClient: with the code-review-graph backend injected and the transport mocked to return the captured fixtures, GraphClient.search/reviewContext/overview/impact/changes return GraphResult.ok=true with correctly-narrowed data, and the sandbox post-filter + kind coercion apply identically to the tokensave path. Unit-tested.
Full suite green (no NEW failures); tokensave path unaffected; lint clean.

nonGoals: Do NOT implement the four query sub-patterns (callers/callees/imports/tests) — Sprint 6.
Do NOT change GraphClient, the transport, or the tokensave backend adapters.
Do NOT normalize cr-graph's scoring/ranking to match tokensave — map the shape faithfully, keep the engine's own semantics.
Do NOT add new fixtures by guessing — use the Sprint-4 captured fixtures; if one is missing/insufficient, capture it live and note it, do not fabricate.
stopConditions: cr-graph search/reviewContext/overview/impact/changes adapters narrow the captured fixtures correctly and return ok GraphResults through GraphClient; suite + lint green
definitionOfDone: CodeReviewGraphBackend implements searchPlan/reviewContextPlan/overviewPlan/impactPlan/changesPlan producing SearchHit[]/string/string/ImpactReport/NodeRef[] validated against Sprint-4 fixtures; GraphClient returns ok results through the cr-graph backend with sandbox + kind coercion intact; tokensave path unchanged; suite + lint green.
assumptions: GraphClient.search consumes SearchHit{node:NodeRef, score, snippet}; reviewContext/overview consume a string (client.ts:270-281); impact consumes an ImpactReport{root, affected, testsAffected} (247-268); changes consumes NodeRef[] (283-294). The cr-graph narrows must produce those exact shapes.

Original cr-graph field names (from 6ed3f77~1) and the live fixtures (Sprint 4) drive the narrows. semantic search likely returns rows with name/file/line/score fields; impact likely returns an affected-node set; review/overview likely return a text/markdown blob. Confirm against the actual fixtures — do not assume.

Kind coercion: reuse the NODE_KINDS set concept (function/class/module/symbol; unknown->symbol) from the tokensave backend. Factor a shared toNodeRef-like helper if cr-graph rows share the name/file/line/kind shape, or keep a cr-graph-specific one.

impact test/non-test partition: the tokensave backend splits affected vs testsAffected via a /test|spec/i heuristic on file path (client.ts:260-261). If the cr-graph impact fixture already tags test edges, prefer that; else reuse the same path heuristic.
The transport is mocked in unit tests (feed the fixture as the unwrapped payload) so these tests are deterministic and need no live binary.
generatorNotes:
Read FIRST: tests/graph/fixtures/cr-graph/*.json (the captured shapes — THESE are your source of truth), the tokensave-backend *Plan methods (the template for {tool, params, narrow}), GraphClient's search/reviewContext/overview/impact/changes (how each result is consumed), and `git show 6ed3f77~1:src/graph/client.ts` (original cr-graph narrows).

IMPLEMENT on CodeReviewGraphBackend: searchPlan(q, opts) -> {tool:'semantic_search_nodes_tool', params (query + limit — match the captured arg shape), narrow: rows->SearchHit[]}; reviewContextPlan(nodes) -> {tool:'get_review_context_tool', params, narrow: raw->string}; overviewPlan() -> {tool:'get_architecture_overview_tool', params, narrow: raw->string (JSON.stringify if it returns an object, matching how tokensave overview stringifies module_api)}; impactPlan(target) -> {tool:'get_impact_radius_tool', params (node id / symbol — match capture), narrow: raw->ImpactReport}; changesPlan(since) -> {tool:'detect_changes_tool', params, narrow: raw->NodeRef[]}.

WRITE the narrows to consume the ACTUAL fixture fields. Add a fixture-driven unit test per operation: load the JSON, call narrow, assert the produced SearchHit/ImpactReport/etc. Add an end-to-end test that injects the cr-graph backend into GraphClient with a mocked transport returning the fixture, asserting GraphResult.ok=true and sandbox filtering applies.

Run `npm run build && npm run typecheck && npx vitest run tests/graph/` + full suite + lint. Commit `bober(sprint-5): code-review-graph read adapters (search/reviewContext/overview/impact/changes)`.
